title: Assistant agentic permission engine review gate

criteria.statement: Permission engine returns canonical allow, ask, and deny decisions using internal/domain assistant permission result types.
Review mode allows read-only assistant tools without approval.
Review mode asks for approval on all assistant mutation tools.
Explicit deny rules override review-mode read allowance for forbidden tools.
Audited mode and argument-driven risk upgrades are available behind the same evaluation interface without app wiring.
